# pvecli ct firewall

Manage the firewall of a container.

## status

Show whether the firewall is enforced here, and why not.

```text
pvecli ct firewall status [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Container ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## rule

Firewall rules of a container

```text
pvecli ct firewall rule
```

## options

Show the firewall options, with the defaults Proxmox applies.

```text
pvecli ct firewall options [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Container ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## ipset

IP sets of a container

```text
pvecli ct firewall ipset
```

## alias

Aliases of a container

```text
pvecli ct firewall alias
```

## log

Show the last lines of the firewall log.

```text
pvecli ct firewall log [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Container ID. |

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--since N` |  | Only lines after this UNIX time. |
| `-l`, `--limit N` | `50` | Number of lines. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` |  | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
